summary: Adopt published governance 0.20.26 without changing Docs behavior

delivery.outcome: Adopt and independently publish the latest final governance package 0.20.26, preserving the Docs 0.2.0 contract and existing repository settings.
nonGoals: No changes to Docs policy, generator contract or test semantics
No unreviewed release, downgrade, default-branch push or automatic merge
No deletion or overwrite of historical or foreign workspaces

architecture.decision: Use Goal atomic published adoption. Its proof covers the managed package; this integration ticket owns only instance manifests and tracking outside that proof. Freshness observations remain separate from authorization and deployed automation.
architecture.rollback: Revert the reviewed adoption commit through protected publication; no existing workspace is relocated or deleted.
